### 🎬 Story cutscenes
- A new survival world now opens with a cinematic intro. You come to on your back in the forest while a stranger, the Drifter, guns down two of the dead closing in on you with an AK.
- He drags you back to your senses by a fire and points you at the work ahead, then walks off into the fog. The campfire he leaves behind is real, so you can use it.
- The scene is fully voiced, with subtitles, lip-synced dialogue and acted characters.
- In co-op, everyone in the world watches the intro together. Nobody can be hurt while it plays, and creatures leave you alone.
- Each story scene plays once per world and is saved with it.

### 🌧️ Weather and night
- Rain now darkens props, buildings, trees and creatures, snow settles on their tops and lightning lights them up — not just the ground
- At night in survival, objects no longer sink into pitch black; they keep a faint moonlit blue

### 🛠️ Fixes
- The Sniper X-ray in arenas outlines only enemies instead of the whole map
- A settlement door closing on you in survival no longer traps you
- In Capture the Flag, a dropped flag now blinks before it returns for every player, not just the host
- Arrows and spears hitting a sentry make a metal impact sound
- Stamping a structure in the map editor keeps its zombie spawns
- A few leftover untranslated texts (death screen, password reset, editor and asset browser labels) are now in English
